summary.en: Iraqi officials say external parties are using Iraqi territory to launch attacks on neighbours while the foreign minister discusses militia weapons regulation with Tehran and regional security arrangements free of outside interference. Flash floods have killed one person, left a child missing in Erbil and caused five deaths and flooding in Kirkuk and the Kurdistan Region, while protests blocked the Mosul-Erbil road in the Nineveh Plains and smuggling of petroleum products was foiled in Diyala and Nineveh. Turkey is supporting Iraqi counter-ISIS operations in Kirkuk and reinforcing border posts, and the U.S. Embassy warned citizens of security risks. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske tjenestemenn sier at utenlandske aktører bruker irakisk territorium til å gjennomføre angrep på naboland, mens utenriksministeren diskuterer regulering av militsvåpen med Teheran og regionale sikkerhetsordninger uten utenlandsk innblanding. Flom har drept én person, etterlatt et barn savnet i Erbil og forårsaket fem dødsfall og oversvømmelser i Kirkuk og Kurdistan-regionen, mens protester blokkerte Mosul-Erbil-veien på Nineveh-sletten og smugling av petroleumsprodukter ble avverget i Diyala og Nineveh. Tyrkia støtter irakiske mot-IS-operasjoner i Kirkuk og forsterker grenseposter, og den amerikanske ambassaden advarte sine borgere om sikkerhetsrisikoer. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
